title: task edit: the QCLI-283 create-spelling refusal narrows the unknown-flag diagnostic (a second bad flag is no longer named)
description: QCLI-283 round-1 review, finding 2 (verdict approve, minor). The new createSpellingFailure early return in src/cli/main.ts runs BEFORE the generic usageFailure/only() path, so quest task edit --label x --badflag y now names only --label and no longer lists the OTHER unrecognized flags, which usageFailure used to report together. Exit code (2) and atomicity (nothing written) are unchanged; the cost is one extra round trip to discover the second bad flag. Filed by the quest-cli worker from the QCLI-283 review; UNSTAMPED.

acceptanceCriteria.text: A quest task edit invocation carrying both a create-only spelling and another unrecognized flag names BOTH in its exit-2 refusal, tested via a real repro, while the create-spelling redirect for the naming split still holds.
